title: Conveyancing Secretary
description:
Conveyancing Secretary
Salary: £30,000 DOE
Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am-5pm
Merthyr Tydfil

Are you an experienced Conveyancing Secretary or Paralegal looking for your next opportunity within the legal sector? We want to hear from you!

We are currently seeking an organised, proactive and detail-oriented Conveyancing Secretary to join a legal team based in Merthyr Tydfil, providing dedicated support to a solicitor within the conveyancing department.

The Role
You will play a key role in supporting the day-to-day running of the conveyancing department, ensuring files are managed efficiently and clients receive a professional and reliable service.

The Ideal Candidate
- At least 3 years' experience in a legal secretarial, conveyancing or relevant paralegal role.
- A good understanding of conveyancing processes and legal terminology.
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- The ability to manage competing priorities and work independently.
- A professional, proactive approach with a strong focus on client service.
- We welcome applications from experienced Conveyancing Secretaries, Legal Secretaries and Paralegals who have the relevant skills and experience to succeed in the role.

Interested?
If you're looking for your next opportunity within conveyancing and feel you have the experience we're looking for, we'd love to hear from you. Please click APPLY

title: Customer Service Assistant
description:
Project Assistant

Salary: £28,000 + Performance Bonus
Location: South Wales
Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

About the Role

Robert Half is recruiting for a highly organised and proactive Project Assistant to support the successful delivery of a range of construction-related projects.

This is an excellent opportunity for an individual with previous project support experience within the construction sector who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and coordinating multiple priorities. You will play a key role in ensuring projects are delivered efficiently, on time, and within scope while supporting project teams with administration, communication, and progress tracking.

Key Responsibilities
- Assist with the planning, coordination, and delivery of project activities
- Maintain accurate project documentation, schedules, and reports
- Monitor project progress and provide regular status updates
- Coordinate project meetings, prepare agendas, and record minutes
- Liaise with internal teams, clients, suppliers, and key stakeholders
- Track project milestones, deliverables, and deadlines
- Support budgeting processes and expense tracking where required
- Identify potential project risks and escalate issues appropriately
- Provide general administrative support to the wider project team
- Ensure project information is organised, up-to-date, and readily accessible

About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:
- Previous experience in a Project Assistant, Project Support, Project Administrator, or similar role
- Experience working within the construction or built environment sector
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
- High attention to detail and strong problem-solving abilities
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
- Experience using project management software and collaboration tools
- A proactive and positive approach to work
- The ability to perform effectively under pressure and meet deadlines

Key Skills
- Project Coordination
- Organisation & Planning
- Stakeholder Management
- Communication & Teamwork
- Time Management
- Problem Solving
- Adaptability & Flexibility
- Administration & Reporting

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £28,000
- Performance-related bonus
- Clear career progression opportunities
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- Opportunity to contribute to a growing and successful project team

If you're an organised and motivated Project Assistant looking to further your career within a dynamic construction environment, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today or contact Robert Half for a confidential discussion.
